commands.author: lwy-2

target.title: fix: harden formatCurrencyAmount, formatCoords, and record code-mode bridge rejections
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Three defensive hardening changes across location formatting, DeepSeek usage formatting, and code-mode bridge promise handling. The gateway-lock handle leak has been dropped (covered by #98848).

## Why This Change Was Made

### 1. Record rejected code-mode bridge promises at pending-state creation boundary

`createPendingBridgeStates` attached a fulfillment-only `.then((settled) => state.settled = settled)` to each bridge promise. A rejection would surface as unhandledRejection.

**Fix:** `.then(onFulfilled, onRejected)` records `{ ok: false, error }` in entry.settled at creation time.

### 2. Guard `formatCurrencyAmount` against non-finite amounts

`formatCurrencyAmount` calls `amount.toFixed(2)` without `Number.isFinite`. NaN produces "$NaN".

### 3. Guard `formatCoords` against NaN/Infinity coordinates

`formatCoords` calls `latitude.toFixed(6)` without `Number.isFinite`. NaN renders as "NaN, NaN".

## User Impact

- **code-mode**: Prevents unhandledRejection from late-rejecting bridge promises. Error preserved in settled state.
- **DeepSeek/location**: Defensive hardening — "unknown" instead of misleading "NaN"/"Infinity".

## Evidence

### Real OpenClaw runtime terminal output

The following proof was generated by loading the **actual OpenClaw TypeScript modules** via `tsx` (the project's TypeScript executor) — the same modules shipped in production. No test framework involved.

#### Location formatCoords
```
$ node_modules/.bin/tsx _runtime-proof.ts
=== OpenClaw Runtime Proof ===
Modules loaded via tsx (real OpenClaw source modules)

--- Location formatCoords ---
Normal:      📍 48.858844, 2.294351
NaN:         📍 unknown
Infinity:    📍 unknown

--- DeepSeek formatCurrencyAmount ---
NaN, USD:    unknown
Inf, CNY:    unknown
42.5, CNY:   ¥42.50

✅ All runtime proofs passed
```

#### Code-mode bridge rejection
```
$ node_modules/.bin/tsx _runtime-proof-codemode.ts
=== OpenClaw Runtime Proof: code-mode bridge rejection ===

waitForPending returned: false
entry.settled.ok = false
entry.settled.error = Error: Simulated bridge failure
unhandledRejection events: 0

✅ Bridge rejection correctly recorded as failed settled state
✅ No unhandledRejection — error preserved for downstream
```

#### Module paths (confirmed loaded)
- `src/channels/location.ts` — formatCoords: `Number.isFinite` guard at line 39
- `src/infra/provider-usage.fetch.deepseek.ts` — formatCurrencyAmount: `Number.isFinite` guard at line 27
- `src/agents/code-mode.ts` — createPendingBridgeStates: `.then(onFulfilled, onRejected)` at line 778, waitForPending: `Promise.all().then(() => true, () => false)` at line 933

#### Before vs After

| Input | Before | After |
|-------|--------|-------|
| Bridge promise rejects | unhandledRejection | `{ ok: false, error }` recorded |
| formatCoords(NaN, NaN) | "NaN, NaN" | "unknown" |
| formatCurrency(NaN, "USD") | "$NaN" | "unknown" |
| Normal values (48.85, 42.50) | Correct | Correct (unchanged) |

## Files Changed (6 files)

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/agents/code-mode.ts` | Record bridge rejections at createPendingBridgeStates boundary |
| `src/agents/code-mode.test.ts` | Test exercises production pending-state creation path |
| `src/channels/location.ts` | formatCoords: add Number.isFinite guard |
| `src/channels/location.test.ts` | 2 new tests for NaN/Infinity coords |
| `src/infra/provider-usage.fetch.deepseek.ts` | formatCurrencyAmount: add Number.isFinite guard |
| `src/infra/provider-usage.fetch.deepseek.test.ts` | 1 new test for non-finite amounts |
